notes: Unity Ludum Dare 58 game from Kettle Game Studio. Play as a witch's black cat gathering creatures for potions; includes a home/witch hub and a multi-phase toad boss fight (Player jump/dash/parry-attack, BattleManager phases, Toad/Fly/Bottle scripts) across Home, Toad, Flower, and Final scenes. MIT (copyright 2025 Kettle Game Studio). Custom image and sound assets under Assets/Images and Assets/Sounds (Banki/Biba/Witch/Toad/Fly); design notes in Docs (Russian). No bundled third-party fonts. No EXE/DLL/LFS/Mannequin/InsertPack/StarterContent/EmojiOne/TMP assets/AssetStore. ~69MB src snapshot.
